s: Look at the picture. The man is holding one of the 　　　. 【109年會考】
e: 根據圖片，這個男人拿的是「玻璃杯」，故答案選(Ｂ)。(Ａ)碗(Ｃ)盤子(Ｄ)湯匙。

s: My mom puts the 　　　 on to keep her hands away from water when she washes the dishes. 【109年會考】
e: 能避免手碰到水的物品，只有「手套」有此功能，故選(Ａ)。(Ｂ)夾克(Ｃ)戒指(Ｄ)襪子。

s: Can you 　　　 your feet a little off the floor?  I want to see if my keys are under the sofa. 【109年會考】
e: 把腳「抬起」來才能讓人看到沙發底下的情景，故答案選(Ｃ)。(Ａ)檢查(Ｂ)踢(Ｄ)表現。

s: of my sisters are older than I am.  I’m the youngest of the three children in my family. 【109年會考】
e: 由　the three children in my family　得知敘述者家中有三個小孩，扣掉敘述者本身，家中還有兩個小孩，故答案選(Ａ)。(Ｂ)很少(Ｃ)大部分(Ｄ)一些。

s: The beach near our town is a very 　　　 place.  Every summer at least one kid dies there in the water. 【109年會考】
e: 由　at least one kid dies there in the water　推知鎮上附近的海灘「很危險」，才會造成小孩死亡，故答案選(Ａ)。(Ｂ)令人興奮的(Ｃ)寂寞的(Ｄ)受歡迎的。

s: It’s great that we can buy train tickets over the phone without going out.  It 　　　 us a lot of time. 【109年會考】
e: 不必出門就可以用手機購買火車票實在是太棒了。這「節省」我們很多時間，故答案選(Ｃ)。(Ａ)借出(Ｂ)準備(Ｄ)花費。

s: Ms. Johnson has been taking phone calls since she entered the office this morning.  Just when she thought she could finally leave work, 　　　 call came in. 【109年會考】
e: 強森女士今天早上進辦公室就一直在接電話。就在她以為終於可以下班的時候，「又有一通」電話響了，故答案選(Ａ)。(Ｂ)每一個(Ｃ)下一個(Ｄ)其他的。(Ｃ)(Ｄ)選項均有限定意思，與題意不符。

s: My wife enjoys going to the movies with her friends, but I like to watch TV at home by 　　　. 【109年會考】
e: but　連接語意相反的句子：妻子喜歡和朋友一起看電影，敘述者喜歡「獨自」在家看電影，故答案選(Ｃ)。

s: For the past twenty years, my father 　　　 in a school library.  But he’ll leave the job next month. 【109年會考】
e: 由　he’ll leave the job next month　得知爸爸下個月才會離職，表示爸爸從過去到「現在」都在學校圖書館工作；能表達「從過去到目前為止」持續的狀態，須用現在完成式，故答案選(Ｂ)。

s: Mozart 　　　 his first music when he was only six years old.〔109.會考〕
e: Mozart　六歲時寫了第一首樂曲，「寫」樂曲的動作僅發生在過去，並未延續到現在，只需用過去簡單式表示，故答案選(Ｄ)。

s: Jill: Have you decided 　　　 you will celebrate your 30<sup>th</sup> birthday?  Sue: Yeah, I’m going to have a big barbecue party. 【109年會考】
e: 由答句：have a big barbecue party.　得知　Jill　是問　Sue　要「如何慶祝　30　歲生日」，故答案選(Ａ)。(Ｂ)　where　用以詢問地點；(Ｃ)　what　用來詢問要做的事，由題目已知要慶生；(Ｄ)　when　用以詢問時間。

s: Alison doesn’t like 　　　 what to do.  She only does things she wants to do. 【109年會考】
e: like　後面接不定詞當受詞；tell　為雙賓動詞，需有「人和事物」兩個受詞，但本句只有受詞　what to do，推知本句為被動語態，故答案選(Ｄ)。

s: Josh has planned to make a trip to New York and 　　　 some of his friends there. 【109年會考】
e: to make　和　to visit　為動詞　plan　的受詞，and　之後省略　to，只寫　visit，故答案選(Ａ)。

s: We were so sure that Jerry 　　　 well on the difficult job.  His past experience in other work showed he was the right guy for it.  So when he failed, no one believed it. 【109年會考】
e: 由　We were so sure...　得知題目為過去式，在過去時間點描述未來會發生的事，使用　will　的過去式　would　來表示，故答案選(Ｄ)。

s: For Mike, the price is 　　　 important thing when he shops for jeans.  He cares even more about the shape and the size of the pockets. 【109年會考】
e: 由第二句　He cares even more about the shape and the size of the pockets.　可知對麥克而言，價錢是他買牛仔褲時「最不重要」的考慮條件，故答案選(Ｄ)。(Ａ)(Ｃ)為比較級，與文法不符(Ｂ)價格為「最重要」的考量，與語意不符。

s: (１)　What is it in the reading?
p:
When it arrives,
Everyone cheers.
The shirts and shorts dance
On the clothesline,
The trees and flowers wave
Like they’re saying hi,
And the clouds are so excited
To have a running race.
When it comes,
Dad’s face falls.
His coat and jeans jump
Off the clothesline
Into the pond.
The tree leaves hop off
And have a party on his new car.
When it gets here,
A lot of fun things I notice:
The pond’s face,
Sad and old with lines;
Mrs. Smith’s bread,
Delicious and freshly baked.
But what smell is it?
Oh, no, it’s from Mr. Brown’s feet!

【109年會考】
e: 因為　it　的緣故，靜態物品（shirts, trees, coats, leaves...）產生動態動作（dance, wave, jump, hop off...），最後一段還提到「氣味」，故答案選(Ｃ)風。

s: (２)　How does Dad feel “when it comes”?
p:
When it arrives,
Everyone cheers.
The shirts and shorts dance
On the clothesline,
The trees and flowers wave
Like they’re saying hi,
And the clouds are so excited
To have a running race.
When it comes,
Dad’s face falls.
His coat and jeans jump
Off the clothesline
Into the pond.
The tree leaves hop off
And have a party on his new car.
When it gets here,
A lot of fun things I notice:
The pond’s face,
Sad and old with lines;
Mrs. Smith’s bread,
Delicious and freshly baked.
But what smell is it?
Oh, no, it’s from Mr. Brown’s feet!

【109年會考】
e: 在第二段第二行，When it comes, Dad’s face falls.表示當爸爸見到 “it” 時，臉「垮下來」，因此推知答案為(Ｃ)他不開心。

s: (１)　What can we learn about Buffy’s friends?
p: 【109年會考】
o: Matt has experience of yard sales.
Jamie had a successful yard sale last week.
Albert thinks weather is important for yard sales.
Debby thinks things are cheaper online than at yard sales.
e: 由　Matt　的回答　I made some good friends at my last yard sale.　得知答案為(Ａ)。(Ｂ)文章未提到；(Ｃ)　Albert　認為辦的時間會有影響，而非天氣；(Ｄ)　Debby　認為在網路上可以賣出更高的價格。

s: (２)　What do Buffy’s friends think about having a yard sale?
p: 【109年會考】
o: Albert and Matt think it’s a nice way to make friends.
Debby and Albert think it’s difficult to make money from it.
Matt agrees with Jamie that it’s a good chance to help people.
Jamie agrees with Debby that it’s a lot of trouble to prepare for it.
e: Debby　覺得庭院大拍賣很花心力和時間，而　Jamie　說　Debby　是對的，可見她同意　Debby　的看法，故答案選(Ｄ)。(Ａ)只有　Matt　認為經由庭院大拍賣可認識朋友；(Ｂ)只有　Debby　認為辦庭院大拍賣很難賺到錢；(Ｃ)　Matt　的留言未提到助人。

s: (１)　From the ad, which is true about Sunny Sun pictures?
p: 【109年會考】
o: The first day to use Sunny Sun pictures is Feb. 4.
The last day to collect Sunny Sun pictures is Feb. 10.
You cannot use Sunny Sun pictures to get free desserts.
You cannot get Sunny Sun pictures when you buy books.
e: 廣告第二行　on anything EXCEPT books and CDs，得知買書籍和　CD　得不到貼紙，故答案選(Ｄ)。(Ａ)使用貼紙的時間從　1　月　4　日開始；(Ｂ)最後收集貼紙的時間是　2　月　4　日；(Ｃ)收集　10　張貼紙「可以」獲得免費甜點。

s: (２)　Sammy has 7 Sunny Sun pictures.  She wants to get a Sunny Cup.  How can she get one?
p: 【109年會考】
o: Use 6 Sunny Sun pictures and pay $100.
Use 6 Sunny Sun pictures and pay $200.
Spend $150 to get 3 more Sunny Sun pictures.
Spend $200 to get 4 more Sunny Sun pictures.
e: 第三點提到集滿　6　張貼紙，可用　200　元加購陽光咖啡杯，故答案選(Ｂ)。(Ａ)加價購需付　200　元；(Ｃ)花　150　元可獲得　3　張貼紙，加上原先的　7　張也只有　10　張，還少　2　張；(Ｄ)花　200　元可獲得　4　張貼紙，加上原有的　7　張，只有　11　張，還少　1　張。

s: (１)　From the reading, which picture best shows the “bain-marie” way of working with chocolate?
p: 【109年會考】
e: 文章第二段中提到將巧克力、奶油及糖放入小鍋中。由文章第三段第一到三行知道大鍋中放溫水，並將小鍋放在大鍋之上。由此可得知答案為(Ｂ)。

s: (２)　What does them mean in the reading?
p: 【109年會考】
e: 由文章第二段可知製作巧克力甜點還需要「奶油和糖」，因此　them　指的是「奶油和糖」。故答案選(Ｂ)。

s: (３)　From the reading, which is true about working with chocolate?
p: 【109年會考】
o: It is better to use a “bain-marie” than a “water bath.”
The water in the pot should not be warmer than 50　℃.
It is better to finish mixing it in less than five minutes.
We should not mix butter and sugar together at the same time.
e:
由文章第三段第三行得知加熱巧克力的水溫應低於　50　度，故答案選(Ｂ)。
(Ａ)「隔水加熱法」即「水浴法」，只是作者偏愛「隔水加熱法」這個稱呼；(Ｃ)要持續混合材料　5　～　10　分鐘；(Ｄ)第二段提到需要將巧克力、奶油及糖混合在一起。

s: (１)　What does the news story say about the Yangs’ food truck?
p: 【109年會考】
o: What people love about their food.
What made them start their business.
How they made delicious fried chicken.
How they fixed their business problems.
e: 第三段提到，他們改變快餐車的顏色、裝飾也改了名字，才讓生意好轉，故答案選(Ｄ)。(Ａ)(Ｃ)(Ｄ)文章中沒有提到。

s: (２)　What does it mean when business is slack?
p: 【109年會考】
e: 第三段提到，很少人會購買他們的食物，甚至連免費的食物都送不出去，表示生意不好，故選(Ａ)。

s: (３)　What does that mean in the news story?
p: 【109年會考】
o: A city block that sells Taiwanese food.
A business that is popular across the country.
e: 最後一段提到，楊氏兄妹的夢想是在曼哈頓能有一個專屬於臺灣食物的街區，就像中國城、韓國城和小義大利區一樣，故選(Ｃ)。

s: (１)　What problem is Selena Bieber trying to fix?
p:
This is a letter by Selena Bieber to the students in her school.


【109年會考】
o: High school lessons are too difficult.
Classes start too early in the morning.
Too many students are late for school.
Lunch break is too short for taking a rest.
e: 由信件標題、第二段的研究結果（有助睡眠的褪黑激素在晚上　11　點到早上　8　點分泌），及第三段的訴求：晚點上課能睡得飽、學得好，故答案選(Ｂ)。(Ａ)(Ｃ)(Ｄ)文章中未提及。

s: (２)　What can we learn from the letter?
p:
This is a letter by Selena Bieber to the students in her school.


【109年會考】
o: Too much melatonin can hurt teenagers’ brain.
The brain stops making melatonin after 11 p.m.
Sleeping longer helps the body make more melatonin.
It is easier to fall asleep when the brain is making melatonin.
e: 由第二段的第一到三行知道褪黑激素的分泌有助於睡眠，故答案選(Ｄ)。(Ａ)(Ｃ)文章未提及；(Ｂ)大腦在晚上　11　點到早上　8　點會分泌褪黑激素。

s:
(３)　Below is some information from another study.
We studied 48 high school students and found that the students who went to bed earlier did better on their school tests. This is not only true for those who slept nine hours, but also true for those who slept less. And some of them agreed that they learned better in early morning classes.
Do the ideas in Selena Bieber’s letter agree with the information?
p:
This is a letter by Selena Bieber to the students in her school.


【109年會考】
o: Yes, because her letter says it is better to sleep from 11 p.m. to 8 a.m.
Yes, because her letter says getting up early is not helpful for learning.
No, because her letter says students are asked to get to school by 7:30 a.m.
No, because her letter says teenagers’ brains do not work well in early morning classes.
e: 由題幹的研究資訊知道，不論是睡滿九小時或睡得少的學生，早睡是他們考試表現良好的共通點，有些學生甚至認為在一大早的課程中他們學得更好。故答案選(Ｄ)。

s: (１)　What can we learn about Kivalina?
p: 【109年會考】
o: It is fighting for one last hope.
It has given up its chance to rise.
e: 第三段提到有民間組織與因紐特人合作拯救基瓦利納。雖然無法確定他們的努力是否有用，但也只能「為最後一線生機搏鬥」，故選(Ｃ)。

s: (２)　What does it mean when we say a place is uninhabitable?
p: 【109年會考】
e: 第一段提及在　2025　年楚科奇海將淹沒此島嶼，可知該字有「不宜居住」之意，故答案選(Ｄ)。

s: (３)　What does the writer think about the Inuit people in Kivalina?
p: 【109年會考】
o: Their way of living has been hurting the earth.
They might not be able to get enough money to move their village.
They should make the oil and power companies fix their problems.
There are better ways than to move their village to somewhere else.
e: 第三段提到遷村需花費上億元，但島民無處可籌錢，故答案選（B）。

s: (４)　What does the reading say about the Arctic ice?
p: 【109年會考】
o: The Arctic ice covered 10 km<sup>2</sup> of Kivalina.
The melting Arctic ice kills about 400 Inuit people each year.
The Arctic ice helped the Inuit people in Kivalina during bad weather.
The melting Arctic ice has given the Inuit people enough water to use.
e: 第二段最後一行提及沒有夠厚的北極冰層為他們遮蔽強風暴雨，可推知答案為(Ｃ)。

p:
克漏字測驗
　　After a lot of tests and interviews, you finally got into a good school or got a good job. But there’s a problem: it’s a long way from home. “Well, I can take the bus or drive,” you might think. But before you decide whether it’s OK to have such a long commute, it’s best to know .
　　Having a long commute means you’ll get fewer hours of sleep, and that’ll make you feel tired easily. You’ll also have less time for friends and family, for exercise, or for a nice meal.
　　A long commute not only eats up your time but also . Studies show that people who have a long commute get fat easily and often have neck or back problems. It’s easier for them to have heart problems too. . Studies find that these people get angry more often, feel less happy with their lives, and do less well at work.
　　Now, does that good school or that good job still sound good to you?

【109年會考】
o: how you can enjoy it more
how it will change your life
what is the best way of commute for you
e: 第二段提及長程通勤讓你的睡眠時間及與家人相處的時間變少，第三段提到健康狀況受影響，故答案選(Ｃ)。

p:
NOlympics in Munich
11/11/2013
　　People in the city of Munich have spoken their mind: they do not want to host the Winter Olympics in 2022. To the cities that fight for this chance, . The Olympics usually do a lot of good to the host city. The Games bring in jobs, visitors, and, most important of all, money. So why did people in Munich say no?
　　The Olympics for people in Munich. For them, the world’s biggest sports festival could invite serious trouble. There would be a lot of　 building work before the Games, and during the Games, too much traffic and too many visitors. Life would become terrible and nature would be hurt. And : Munich hosted the 1972 Summer Olympics, and its neighbor, the mountain town Garmisch-Partenkirchen, hosted the 1936 Winter Olympics.
　　Still, the heavy price Munich paid does not worry the cities that are in the race to get the 2022 Winter Olympics. , they are happy that Munich said no to the Olympics　—　their chances of getting the Games have become higher.

【109年會考】
o: this sounds like a good idea
this is perhaps a smart answer
this is old news they have heard
e: 慕尼黑不想承辦冬奧，讓其他有意爭取的城市少了競爭對手，所以是個驚喜，故選(Ａ)。
